title: Open and save embedded-file attachments with pdfxi attachments --extract
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-core --lib links and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi attachments --extract writes the decoded embedded payload and rejects traversal names; VIEW-009 moves to verified.
notes: Adds Document::attachment_bytes (spec lookup through the EmbeddedFiles name tree or FileAttachment annotations, EF/F stream decode through the filter chain, AttachmentNotFound) and CLI extraction with a name sanitiser and collision handling.
